text.text_excerpt: I ate here last Friday night and honestly it was one of the best meals I have had in New Orleans recently...or maybe even ever. We had a party of 3 and basically ordered one of everything on the menu. (they had unfortunately just ran out of the sliders, which we will definitely be trying for our next visit). My favorites were the seared scallops, sugar snap peas, beets and sweet potato. The scallops were cooked perfectly, full of flavor and had a lovely meyer lemon shiitake mushroom sauce accompanying them. I loved the bleu cheese with the beets and the sweet potato was dessert-like with candied pecans. Entrees are $15 which includes 2 sides and starters are $5. The quality and the price ...

Wow, I don't know where to start here. This food was tremendous! That's a good place start from. Emily, the waitress and wife of the chef, was super friendly and the service in the bar was great. This is not a classy establishment but the food, OMG the food... One of the best meals I've had in NOLA. This is not fried butter covered gravy soaked soul food. I had roasted herbed potatoes, roasted cauliflower with pork belly, beet salad (yum!) with mangos and almond slivers, and a balsamic glazed pork chop. Everything was cook to perfection! Will be back

Im not even sure if I ever gave 5 stars but Chef Tres is a mean cook. I have been to milkfish at maries bar and noticed they are there on Fridays. It happened to be Friday, weather was gorgeous so I hopped on the scoot and headed over to check them out. I got the flank steak, cauliflower, and the turnips. The flank steak had a perfect marinade that was very noticible because the steak was cooked perfectly rare. The sides could not have been cooked better and the spices were perfect. For the appetizer I got the red bean puree with sausage on sticks. Again, the sausage was perfectly cooked on an outside grill and the pureed red beans were perfect. One of my favorites I cook from time to tim...
